SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.batch_id) AS completed_batches,
    COUNT(st.id) AS total_transactions,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE st.is_cancellation
    ) AS cancellation_records,
    MIN(st.invoice_date) AS first_transaction_date,
    MAX(st.invoice_date) AS last_transaction_date
FROM ingestion_batches b
LEFT JOIN sales_transactions st
    ON st.batch_id = b.batch_id
WHERE b.status = 'completed';

WITH revenue_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_transaction_lines,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT st.is_cancellation
        ) AS sales_transaction_lines,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(st.line_amount) FILTER (
                WHERE NOT st.is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS gross_revenue,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(ABS(st.line_amount)) FILTER (
                WHERE st.is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS cancellation_value

    FROM sales_transactions st
    INNER JOIN ingestion_batches b
        ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id
    WHERE b.status = 'completed'
)

SELECT
    total_transaction_lines,
    sales_transaction_lines,
    gross_revenue,
    cancellation_value,
    gross_revenue - cancellation_value AS net_revenue
FROM revenue_metrics;

WITH order_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT is_cancellation
        ) AS completed_orders,

        COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FILTER (
            WHERE is_cancellation
        ) AS cancelled_orders,

        COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS total_invoices,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(quantity) FILTER (
                WHERE NOT is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS total_items_sold,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(line_amount) FILTER (
                WHERE NOT is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS gross_revenue,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(ABS(line_amount)) FILTER (
                WHERE is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS cancellation_value

    FROM sales_transactions st
    INNER JOIN ingestion_batches b
        ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id
    WHERE b.status = 'completed'
)

SELECT
    completed_orders,
    cancelled_orders,
    total_invoices,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * cancelled_orders /
        NULLIF(total_invoices, 0),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_rate_pct,

    total_items_sold,

    ROUND(
        total_items_sold::NUMERIC /
        NULLIF(completed_orders, 0),
        2
    ) AS average_items_per_order,

    gross_revenue,
    cancellation_value,

    ROUND(
        gross_revenue / NULLIF(completed_orders, 0),
        2
    ) AS average_order_value

FROM order_metrics;

WITH product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT is_cancellation
        ) AS distinct_products_sold,

        SUM(quantity) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT is_cancellation
        ) AS total_units_sold,

        SUM(ABS(quantity)) FILTER (
            WHERE is_cancellation
        ) AS cancellation_units

    FROM sales_transactions st
    INNER JOIN ingestion_batches b
        ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id
    WHERE b.status = 'completed'
),

top_products_quantity AS (
    SELECT
        stock_code,
        MAX(description) AS product_name,
        SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,
        SUM(line_amount) AS gross_revenue
    FROM sales_transactions st
    INNER JOIN ingestion_batches b
        ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id
    WHERE
        b.status = 'completed'
        AND NOT st.is_cancellation
    GROUP BY stock_code
    ORDER BY units_sold DESC
    LIMIT 10
),

top_products_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        stock_code,
        MAX(description) AS product_name,
        SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,
        SUM(line_amount) AS gross_revenue
    FROM sales_transactions st
    INNER JOIN ingestion_batches b
        ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id
    WHERE
        b.status = 'completed'
        AND NOT st.is_cancellation
    GROUP BY stock_code
    ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
)

SELECT
    (
        SELECT row_to_json(pm)
        FROM product_metrics pm
    ) AS overall_metrics,

    (
        SELECT json_agg(tq)
        FROM top_products_quantity tq
    ) AS top_10_by_quantity,

    (
        SELECT json_agg(tr)
        FROM top_products_revenue tr
    ) AS top_10_by_revenue;

WITH country_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        st.country,

        COUNT(DISTINCT st.invoice_no) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT st.is_cancellation
        ) AS completed_orders,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT st.is_cancellation
        ) AS sales_transaction_lines,

        SUM(st.quantity) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT st.is_cancellation
        ) AS units_sold,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(st.line_amount) FILTER (
                WHERE NOT st.is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS gross_revenue,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(ABS(st.line_amount)) FILTER (
                WHERE st.is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS cancellation_value

    FROM sales_transactions st
    INNER JOIN ingestion_batches b
        ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id

    WHERE b.status = 'completed'

    GROUP BY st.country
),

country_summary AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        completed_orders,
        sales_transaction_lines,
        units_sold,
        gross_revenue,
        cancellation_value,

        gross_revenue - cancellation_value AS net_revenue,

        ROUND(
            gross_revenue / NULLIF(completed_orders, 0),
            2
        ) AS average_order_value

    FROM country_metrics
),

top_countries AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM country_summary
    ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
)

SELECT
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM country_summary
    ) AS total_countries,

    (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(completed_orders), 0)
        FROM country_summary
    ) AS total_completed_orders,

    (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gross_revenue), 0)
        FROM country_summary
    ) AS total_gross_revenue,

    (
        SELECT json_agg(
            tc ORDER BY tc.gross_revenue DESC
        )
        FROM top_countries tc
    ) AS top_10_countries;

WITH completed_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        st.invoice_date::DATE AS sales_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', st.invoice_date)::DATE AS sales_month,
        st.invoice_no,
        st.quantity,
        st.line_amount,
        st.is_cancellation

    FROM sales_transactions st
    INNER JOIN ingestion_batches b
        ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id

    WHERE b.status = 'completed'
),

daily_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        sales_date,

        COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT is_cancellation
        ) AS completed_orders,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(line_amount) FILTER (
                WHERE NOT is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS gross_revenue,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(ABS(line_amount)) FILTER (
                WHERE is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS cancellation_value

    FROM completed_transactions
    GROUP BY sales_date
),

monthly_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        sales_month,

        COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT is_cancellation
        ) AS completed_orders,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(quantity) FILTER (
                WHERE NOT is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS units_sold,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(line_amount) FILTER (
                WHERE NOT is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS gross_revenue,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(ABS(line_amount)) FILTER (
                WHERE is_cancellation
            ),
            0
        ) AS cancellation_value

    FROM completed_transactions
    GROUP BY sales_month
),

monthly_growth AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        gross_revenue - cancellation_value AS net_revenue,

        LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (
            ORDER BY sales_month
        ) AS previous_month_revenue

    FROM monthly_metrics
),

monthly_results AS (
    SELECT
        sales_month,
        completed_orders,
        units_sold,
        gross_revenue,
        cancellation_value,
        net_revenue,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * (
                gross_revenue - previous_month_revenue
            ) / NULLIF(previous_month_revenue, 0),
            2
        ) AS revenue_growth_pct

    FROM monthly_growth
)

SELECT
    (
        SELECT json_agg(
            d ORDER BY d.sales_date
        )
        FROM daily_metrics d
    ) AS daily_metrics,

    (
        SELECT json_agg(
            m ORDER BY m.sales_month
        )
        FROM monthly_results m
    ) AS monthly_metrics;
